description: This file is a TypeScript declaration file for a custom Buffer class that extends Uint8Array, providing method signatures and constructors for buffer manipulation. It defines the Buffer class interface, including methods for reading, writing, copying, slicing, and comparing buffers, as well as static factory methods.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A class extending Uint8Array that adds various buffer manipulation methods, mimicking Node.js Buffer API.

methods.name: write(string: string, offset?: number, length?: number, encoding?: string): number; write
methods.description: Writes a string to the buffer at the specified offset.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the buffer contents to a string with optional encoding and range.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Returns a JSON representation of the buffer.

methods.name: equals(otherBuffer: Buffer): boolean; equals
methods.description: Checks if another Buffer is equal to this one.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares this buffer with another Buffer.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from this buffer into a target buffer.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Creates a new Buffer from a sub-region of this buffer.
